# Q19 teardown image corpus

Source: Steward Fu public research repository `steward-fu/website`, branch `gh-pages`.

Original page:
https://steward-fu.github.io/website/handheld/q19_teardown.htm

Original repository directory:
https://github.com/steward-fu/website/tree/gh-pages/handheld/q19_teardown

Captured into XGO archaeology on 2026-09-07.

## Integrity

All 16 JPEGs were copied byte-for-byte from the upstream Git repository. Because Git blobs are content-addressed, each archived file has the exact same Git blob SHA-1 as its upstream original.

This directory is external comparative evidence only. It is **not** an XGO teardown and must not be treated as evidence that the A10 uses an identical PCB.

## Key hardware evidence

The corpus documents the Q19 power-bank handheld board marked:

`XYC-Q20-A-V3.0`
`2023-04-14`
`T=1.0mm`

Visible/identified parts include the 1-Gbit Hynix DDR2 RAM, UC25HQ40 SPI NOR, IP5219 power-management circuitry, LCD 24-pin FPC, battery, microSD, AV/USB ports, audio circuitry and the processor package with its marking removed.

The Q19 is preserved because it is a close SF2000/B210-family power-bank hardware comparator relevant to the DY19 → XGO lineage investigation.

## File map

- 1–6: exterior and enclosure/port views
- 7–8: opened unit and battery/mainboard relationship
- 9–11: card, controls and shell internals
- 12–13: PCB assembly views
- 14: LCD/FPC detail
- 15–16: high-value component-side motherboard/detail views

Copyright remains with the original photographer/publisher. These copies are retained for research, preservation and provenance.
